messages:
alice.w: kicking off midnight rollout now. plan: EU canary 5% -> US staged 20% -> APAC warm 5% later. target version redwood-serve-v1.13. change window 00:30-02:00 PT. assigning @oncall-bot for watch.

bob.k: noted. capacity precheck done for EU/US, APAC warm pool low (only 3 warm nodes).

carol_sre: flag — APAC GPU spare count looks marginal. recommend holding APAC until we confirm warmup + burst capacity.

alice.w: ok hold APAC. proceed EU canary only. US remain pinned to v1.12 for now. we will gather 10m metrics before progressing.

deploy-bot: START: rollout initiated by alice.w
- slice: eu-west-1 (canary)
- target: 5% traffic to v1.13
- instances: 12 (GPU pool)
- policy: auto-fallback -> v1.12

deploy-bot: INVESTIGATION: health checks streaming
```
req_rps: 430
p95_latency_ms: 128
errors_pct: 0.8
cpu_util: 74%
queue_depth: 2
```

dinesh: seeing a small spike in transient 429s from a downstream cache in EU, on it.

eva: adding temporary retry backoff rule on EU canary route: 2 retries, jitter.

bob.k: quick perf check: p95 healthy, throughput close to expected. error bump localized, not systemic.

carol_sre: threshold checks for canary -> rollback if errors_pct > 1.5% sustained for 3 minutes OR p95 > 200ms. logging alert rule updated.

alice.w: agreement. leave US pinned. APAC hold. If EU stays within thresholds for 10m, we'll open US to 10% then 20%.

deploy-bot: METRICS (t+4m): errors_pct=0.95%, p95=140ms, rps=460, gpu_free=0.15 (15%)

dinesh: cache fix deployed at +5m, errors dropped. still watching for tail latency.

eva: rolling config note — canary route has prefix-caching enabled; this should improve short-seq latency in EU.

alice.w: good. set US plan: staged ramp to 10% in 10 minutes, 20% after 25 minutes if green. pin fallback ready. also add manual abort contact: @carol_sre and @dinesh.

bob.k: APAC ops — I'll request 4 more warm nodes (estimate 6 total) and increase burst limit. currently waiting on quota approval.

deploy-bot: ACTION: US remains pinned to v1.12. scheduling staged ramp to v1.13 at +12m if EU status == green.

carol_sre: FYI: new rollback criteria included in release notes: 
- error_rate_threshold: 1.5%
- latency_threshold_p95_ms: 200
- sustained_window_sec: 180
- manual_override: immediate by oncall

alice.w: copy. also note cost-control: enable batching fast-path on v1.13 for US stage to keep token cost ~5% lower.

bob.k: quota approved for APAC warm nodes (4 added). still need to run warmup script `scripts/warmup_pool.sh --region apac --concurrency 20`.

bob.k: running warmup now. ETA ~6m.

deploy-bot: NOTICE: EU canary passed 10m health gate. errors_pct avg 0.9%, p95 135ms. progressing to US staged ramp at 10%

alice.w: proceeding with US ramp. remember to watch the trace sampler for regressions. if any model-quality regression alerts fire, revert immediately.

carol_sre: oncall ready. I will monitor SLO dashboard and run a quick smoke query set after each bump.

dinesh: if we get saturated queues (>10) or GPU_free < 8% during US ramp, auto-throttle and notify channel.

eva: logging note: include `release_id:3035002468` in all eval logs for postmortem correlation.

deploy-bot: ACTION: US ramp started -> 10% traffic to v1.13

deploy-bot: METRICS (US t+2m): rps=2100, p95=155ms, errors=0.7%, gpu_free=12%

bob.k: looks nominal. continuing to 20% in 12m if steady.

alice.w: if US steady at 20% for 15m, we open APAC to 5% warm and run an additional small canary there. but only after confirming warmup script completed.

deploy-bot: UPDATE: APAC warmup finished, nodes healthy, warm pool size: 6

carol_sre: last check-in: EU & US metrics green. APAC will be a small warm canary with strict rollback. final decision in 10m.

alice.w: thanks team. keep reactions short, call out immediately if thresholds hit. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: oncall alert channel monitored. if escalation required, ping sequence: carol_sre -> dinesh -> alice.w

deploy-bot: COMPLETE: staged rollout ongoing. logs tagged release_id=3035002468.

alice.w: thread will stay open for the change window. if no regressions, we'll finalize release notes and close at 02:00 PT.
